The '''Sundari Warehouse District''' was a district in the [[New Mandalorians/Legends|New Mandalorian]] [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Sundari/Legends|Sundari]]. In [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]] [[Prime Minister/Legends|Prime Minister]] [[Almec/Legends|Almec]] used a [[Government warehouse/Legends|warehouse]] to store black market supplies.
